# Rampwise

> Rampwise is a free, open-source (Apache-2.0) set of AI agent skills that coaches a runner or cyclist from their own Garmin data: evidence-labelled training plans, daily adaptation of the next session, an injury-risk watch, chronic/acute training load (CTL, ATL, TSB) as context, nutrition (calories and macros to cut, bulk or maintain, day-by-day meal plans, race-day fuelling times) and daily/weekly/monthly reports. It runs inside an AI agent such as Claude Code. Independent project, not affiliated with Garmin Ltd. Experimental: built and tested on one person's data.

## Start here
- [README](https://github.com/Azahir21/rampwise/blob/main/README.md): what it does, requirements, install, first run
- [Install for your AI tool](https://github.com/Azahir21/rampwise/blob/main/docs/INSTALL.md): one installer for 30 tools (or `npx skills add Azahir21/rampwise`), folders per tool with the official pages read
- [Other watch brands and Strava](https://github.com/Azahir21/rampwise/blob/main/docs/OTHER-WATCHES.md): .fit files from any maker, Strava draft, what stays Garmin-only
- [Sample weekly report](https://azahir21.github.io/rampwise/sample/): interactive report built from synthetic data
- [Disclaimer](https://github.com/Azahir21/rampwise/blob/main/DISCLAIMER.md): not medical advice; no promise of results
- [Privacy](https://github.com/Azahir21/rampwise/blob/main/PRIVACY.md): what stays on your computer

## Evidence
- [Paper list](https://github.com/Azahir21/rampwise/blob/main/docs/PAPERS.md): every paper behind the rules, with DOI
- Each skill folder has `references/evidence-map.md`, where every rule is labelled research, practice or gap
- `skills/rampwise/scripts/paper_fetch.py`: the coach fetches the full text of open-access papers on demand (Europe PMC); paywalled papers stay abstract-only and are labelled so
